name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 1995 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 1995 record supports: the eighteen CERT/CC advisories CA-95:01 to CA-95:18 and the June 1995 CERT heads-up on IP spoofing, CIAC bulletin F-20 and the SATAN authors' summary, Shimomura's own account of the Christmas Day 1994 intrusion, the Justice Department releases on the Harvard intruder, the Monmouth mail-bomb release, the Net'Strike call and Virus Bulletin on Concept. No 1995 source prints an ATT&CK id: every entry is this study's later mapping. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_1995.md. Scores: 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
